_comment_thresholds: Performance: 0.80 floor. The hero loads Three.js + GSAP + Swiper + AOS +
Typed.js from CDN and embeds a YouTube iframe for background music, so
100 isn't realistic; 80 is the line where 'something genuinely regressed'.
Accessibility: 0.95 floor. The axe-core suite in tests/smoke catches
critical/serious violations as hard fails; Lighthouse's score is the
Best-practices and SEO are kept at 0.90 as quality floors.

_comment_metrics: Core Web Vitals thresholds. 'warn' rather than 'error' so a brief
blip from YouTube/CDN cold-start doesn't fail the build.
_comment_disabled: Disabled: third-party-cookies fires on the YouTube embed which is
kept on purpose. uses-text-compression is already gzip'd by Pages
but the bundled audit doesn't always detect it.
